how_to_apply: Download the application notification and details from www.keralauniversity.ac.in/jobs.
Write your application on plain paper and attach a passport-size photograph.
Enclose a copy of your Aadhaar card and caste certificates if applying under reserved categories.
Include contact details including a mandatory phone number.
Send the completed application by post to the designated address: Warden, Women's Hostel, University of Kerala, Kariavattom Campus, Kariavattom P.O., Thiruvananthapuram – 695581.
Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 26-10-2026 by 04:00 PM.
important_instructions: Applications received after the specified closing date and time (26-10-2026, 04:00 PM) will not be accepted. Resident Cook post requires the selected candidate to stay at the hostel and carry out duties. Applications without mandatory phone numbers or required document copies will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. What is Kerala University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an official recruitment notification issued by Kerala University to hire women candidates for Resident Cook and Kitchen Helper positions on contract and daily wage bases.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: The exact number of vacancies is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 26-10-2026 up to 04:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates with prior experience in cooking are given preference, and applicants must be women.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 55 years.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications offline by post to the Warden, Women's Hostel, University of Kerala, Kariavattom Campus, Thiruvananthapuram – 695581.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary is based on contract (for Resident Cook) and daily wage (for Kitchen Helper) terms, but exact pay figures are not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. Is a written exam required?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify a written examination or detailed selection stages.

faq.question: Q10. Who can I contact for inquiries?
faq.answer: For detailed inquiries, you can contact 6238349186 or 0471 2308808.
